banarasi.iron: No direct iron. Steam from distance only
banarasi.storage: Wrap in muslin cloth, store flat or rolled. Never fold zari on itself
banarasi.notes: Store with silica gel packets to prevent tarnishing of zari. Air out before storing.
banarasi.monsoon: Airtight box with silica gel and neem leaves; check monthly for zari tarnish.

chiffon.iron: Lowest heat setting with pressing cloth, or steam
chiffon.notes: Extremely delicate. Handle with care to avoid pulls or tears.
chiffon.monsoon: Quick-dry; keep away from damp walls to prevent water marks.

cotton.notes: Can be machine dried on low. Use mild detergent.
cotton.monsoon: Dry completely before storing; damp cotton mildews fast in monsoon.

crepe.wash: Hand wash or gentle machine wash in cold water
crepe.iron: Medium heat, steam setting works well
crepe.monsoon: Quick-dry; store flat in a dry drawer.

georgette.wash: Hand wash cold or dry clean
georgette.iron: Low heat steam iron on reverse side
georgette.notes: Handle gently — georgette can snag. Do not wring.
georgette.monsoon: Dries fast — ideal monsoon fabric. Hang in a ventilated wardrobe.

kanjeevaram.wash: Dry clean recommended; hand wash in cold water as alternative
kanjeevaram.iron: Iron on reverse side with pressing cloth on medium heat
kanjeevaram.storage: Wrap in muslin, store folded with tissue between pleats
kanjeevaram.notes: Never expose to harsh chemicals. Rotate storage every 3-6 months to prevent creasing.
kanjeevaram.monsoon: Muslin wrap plus silica gel; refold along different lines every month.

khadi.wash: Hand wash cold with mild soap
khadi.iron: High heat on slightly damp fabric
khadi.storage: Store folded in a clean cotton bag
khadi.notes: Gets softer with each wash. Air dry in shade to prevent fading.
khadi.monsoon: Dry thoroughly in shade; khadi holds moisture and can mildew.

linen.wash: Machine wash cold or hand wash
linen.iron: Iron while slightly damp on high heat
linen.notes: Air dry flat. Embrace natural wrinkles or steam.
linen.monsoon: Air out weekly; store with silica gel to avoid musty smell.

net.wash: Hand wash very gently or dry clean
net.iron: Do not iron directly. Use pressing cloth on lowest heat
net.storage: Store flat to prevent distortion of weave
net.notes: Extremely delicate fabric — store away from rough surfaces.
net.monsoon: Hang loosely; humidity can make net sag if folded tight.

polyester.iron: Low heat only — polyester melts at high temperatures
polyester.notes: Avoid high heat in dryer. Washes and dries quickly.
polyester.monsoon: Monsoon-friendly; dries fast and resists mildew.

raw_silk.wash: Dry clean recommended; hand wash cold as alternative
raw_silk.iron: Low heat on reverse side with pressing cloth
raw_silk.storage: Store hanging in muslin cloth, avoid plastic
raw_silk.notes: Avoid water spots. Do not wring. Keep in cool, dry place.
raw_silk.monsoon: Store in muslin with silica gel; avoid plastic covers that trap humidity.

rayon.wash: Hand wash cold or dry clean; avoid machine wash
rayon.iron: Low to medium heat with steam
rayon.notes: May shrink in hot water. Do not wring. Air dry in shade.
rayon.monsoon: Dry fully before folding; rayon weakens when damp.

satin.wash: Hand wash cold or dry clean
satin.iron: Iron on reverse side on low heat with pressing cloth
satin.storage: Hang or fold with tissue paper
satin.notes: Avoid snags. Keep away from sharp jewelry when wearing.
satin.monsoon: Store in a cool dry place; humidity dulls the sheen.

silk.wash: Hand wash cold with silk-safe detergent OR dry clean
silk.iron: Low heat iron (silk/delicate setting), use pressing cloth
silk.storage: Hang on padded hangers or store in muslin bag
silk.notes: Never wring. Keep away from direct sunlight to prevent fading.
silk.monsoon: Keep in a breathable muslin bag with silica gel; never store damp.

unknown.wash: Hand wash cold or dry clean
unknown.storage: Fold and store in a dry place
unknown.notes: Fabric not identified yet — edit the item to get accurate care advice.
unknown.monsoon: Store dry with silica gel during monsoon.

velvet.iron: Steam only, never direct iron — will crush pile
velvet.storage: Hang separately to prevent pile crushing
velvet.notes: Brush gently with soft brush to restore pile. Store with cedar blocks.
velvet.monsoon: Avoid wearing in monsoon; store in a garment bag with silica gel.
